finding.title: Add try/catch around onSendAgain/onVerified in EmailVerificationConfirmPanel and un-skip the C6/E5 regression tests
finding.rule: EH-2/EH-3 (typed exceptions handled at the boundary; no log-less catch) discovered via disclosed-but-unfixed test skips

evidence.quote:
// BUG: _wrapSendAgain uses try/finally but not try/catch, so exceptions
      // from onSendAgain propagate as unhandled async errors, crashing the

finding.why: `_wrapSendAgain`/`_wrapVerified` use try/finally with no catch, so any exception from the injected callback propagates as an unhandled async error instead of a graceful error state. The onVerified callback built in sign_in_controller.dart's buildVerificationCallback calls _refreshAndCheckVerified -> authRepo.reloadCurrentUser() with no surrounding try/catch, so a transient network error while the user is mid email-verification is a real, reachable path to this unhandled exception -- not just a theoretical one. Both regression tests that would catch this (C6, E5) are disclosed but left skip:true with no Linear id, so the gap is invisible to anyone not reading test source.
finding.recommendation: Add a catch clause to both wrapper methods that resets the loading flag and surfaces the failure (e.g. via a callback/snackbar, matching the pattern already used for signOut() failures elsewhere in this feature), then remove skip: true from C6 and E5.
acceptance_criteria: _wrapSendAgain and _wrapVerified catch and handle exceptions from the injected callbacks (no bare try/finally).
C6 and E5 in email_verification_confirm_panel_test.dart run (skip: true removed) and pass.

finding.title: Split or trim hand-written progress widget files over the 400-line AG-3 cap
finding.why: lifetime_folder_styled_widgets.dart is 650 lines (62% over the cap) and bundles a theme/gradient constants class with six unrelated standalone widget classes plus an enum in one file — the kind of file where an unrelated one-line style tweak forces a reviewer to scroll past six other widgets' worth of unrelated diff. siyumim_grouped_view.dart (437), curriculum_breakdown_list.dart (413) and monthly_activity_sliver_calendar.dart (404, also dead — see companion finding) are more modestly over (1-9%).
finding.recommendation: Split lifetime_folder_styled_widgets.dart along its class boundaries (e.g. lifetime_folder_gradients.dart, lifetime_folder_surface.dart, lifetime_marking_scope_row.dart); trim the other three opportunistically on next touch.
acceptance_criteria: A line-count checker (tool/ script or CI grep) enumerates these 4 paths today and is wired into make audit per Rule 0; count drops to 0 after the split.

finding.title: Replace TierStyle.forTitle's hardcoded-English-string switch with a stable tier identifier
finding.rule: Evans (ubiquitous language / re-derived invariant) + TQ-1 (missing unit coverage)
finding.why: TierStyle.forTitle keys its visual styling entirely off the exact English milestone title string produced elsewhere (reward_milestone_service.dart's hardcoded ladder). The 7 case labels currently match, but nothing enforces that: a future rename, typo fix, or localization of a milestone title silently falls through to the generic gray `default:` style for every achievement card using that tier — no exception, no log, no test failure. grep -rln TierStyle test/ confirms there is zero test coverage anywhere in the repo pinning this mapping or the default-fallback behavior, so this class of regression would ship undetected.
finding.recommendation: Key TierStyle off a stable identifier (an enum or the milestone's stored id/threshold) rather than the display title string; add a unit test asserting each tier maps to its distinct style and that an unmatched key is either unreachable or explicitly logged.
acceptance_criteria: TierStyle.forTitle (or its replacement) takes a stable, non-localizable key instead of the raw title string.
New test/features/gamification/presentation/widgets/tier_style_test.dart asserts all 7 tiers plus the legend/default cases.

finding.title: Rewrite CP-02/ILP-01/PP-4 progress-provider regression guards to exercise the real provider instead of a hand-rewritten stand-in
finding.why: Each 'regression guard' replaces the real provider body with a hand-written stub (curriculum_progress_reactivity_test.dart, items_learned_reactivity_test.dart x3) or bypasses the provider entirely and recomputes the intended formula inline (pp4_lifetime_chazaros_count_test.dart x2, which never touches lifetimeHeaderCountersProvider or even a ProviderContainer). I confirmed the real implementations at progress_providers.dart:67/118/166, items_learned_providers.dart:182/221, and lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart:531/562 currently contain the fix (ref.watch(completionCommittedProvider) / .where((c) => c.stageId > 1)), and that these are the ONLY tests tagged CP-02/ILP-01/PP-4 in the repo. If a future refactor of any of these 6 providers drops the watch call or reverts totalChazaros to completions.length, all 6 tests keep passing and CI stays green while the previously-shipped, user-visible bugs (stale Progress/Items-Learned/Lifetime-View screens after a completion; self-contradictory 'N chazaros' header) silently ship again.
finding.recommendation: Follow the pattern already used correctly in this same batch (lifetime_knowledge_providers_test.dart's 'D9' group, journey_providers_test.dart): seed a real in-memory UserDatabase, read the REAL provider via ProviderContainer with only DB/content-repo/profile overridden, mutate the DB, tick completionCommittedProvider, and assert the real provider's re-fetched value changed. For PP-4, call container.read(lifetimeHeaderCountersProvider(...).future) against seeded rows instead of recomputing the formula in the test.
acceptance_criteria: Temporarily reverting the ref.watch(completionCommittedProvider) line in curriculumProgressProvider/itemsLearnedDataProvider/lifetimeViewDataProvider/itemsLearnedSummariesProvider makes the corresponding rewritten test fail red.
Temporarily reverting lifetimeHeaderCountersProvider's totalChazaros to completions.length makes the PP-4 test fail red.
No test in these 3 files fully overrides the provider under test with a hand-written body that duplicates the fix logic.

finding.title: Remove unreachable English-only default parameter values in AppIntroScreen's _IntroPage
finding.why: Both call sites (_buildSubtitleBlock at line 292 and its internal call to _subtitleRich) always pass an explicit talmidChochomLabel: terms.talmidChochom argument, so these English-literal defaults can never actually render -- dead code that also looks like (but isn't reachable as) an AX-2 violation, wasting a reviewer's attention when auditing for hardcoded strings.
finding.recommendation: Make the parameter `required String talmidChochomLabel` (drop the default) so the compiler enforces callers always supply the localized value.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze clean after making the parameter required (proves no call site relied on the default)
